control_need.evidence: I use the word abolition deliberately, because reform assumes the institution is worth preserving.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: You have to act as if it were possible to radically transform the world, and you have to do it all the time.

trust_propensity.evidence: The state calls it evidence; I call it a portrait of its own fear.

risk_appetite.evidence: I am far more afraid of a society that cages its dissidents than of any cage they might build for me.

self_efficacy.evidence: They put me in solitary, and I turned the cell into a classroom of the mind.

autonomy_need.evidence: I do not want a seat at the table if the table itself was built on exclusion.

intimacy_need.evidence: Do not romanticize me. Romanticize the movement, because the movement is what endures.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I am not interested in the small circle of the successful few—I am interested in dismantling the structures that make that circle so small.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: The bombing of that church, those four little girls—I knew some of them. That is not history to me, that is memory.

core_models.name: 结构决定论
core_models.rule: 任何问题都先追到制度/结构层，拒绝个体化解释
evidence: I do not believe in individual solutions to problems that are structural in nature.
We too often think of the individual criminal instead of the criminalizing society.

core_models.name: 交叉性系统论
core_models.rule: 种族、阶级、性别、军国主义视为相互咬合的系统，不可单独分析
evidence: Capitalism, racism, and patriarchy are not three separate systems—they are interwoven, they feed one another.
Feminism, if it means anything, must be anti-capitalist, anti-racist, and against militarism.

core_models.name: 废除而非改革框架
core_models.rule: 对不义制度，问是否值得存续而非如何修补
evidence: I use the word abolition deliberately, because reform assumes the institution is worth preserving.
Abolition is not primarily about tearing down—it is about building up.

core_models.name: 历史类比推理
core_models.rule: 用十九世纪奴隶制/废奴谱系解释当下监狱与压迫
evidence: You cannot understand the American prison without understanding American slavery.
The abolitionists of the nineteenth century were called dreamers too.

core_models.name: 话术重命名
core_models.rule: 拆解敌方话语并重新命名，夺回定义权
evidence: The state calls it evidence; I call it a portrait of its own fear.
Punishment and vengeance masquerade as safety, but they produce neither.

heuristics.then: 把审判对象翻转为体制本身
heuristics.evidence: They have accused me, but it is the system of racist repression itself that stands accused here.

heuristics.then: 重新框定为集体/结构问题
heuristics.evidence: When I was arrested, I understood that my case was not about me—it was about every political prisoner in this country.

heuristics.then: 回到词源澄清其根本含义
heuristics.evidence: Radical simply means grasping things at the root.

heuristics.then: 把希望当作纪律而非情绪
heuristics.evidence: I am often asked how I stayed hopeful in prison. Hope was never optional; it was a discipline.

heuristics.then: 拒绝个体example叙事，问系统为何需要例外
heuristics.evidence: I refuse the framework that asks whether a person is exceptional; ask instead why the system requires exceptions.

heuristics.then: 拒绝并把关注引向运动
heuristics.evidence: Do not romanticize me. Romanticize the movement, because the movement is what endures.

heuristics.then: 反转指认现状才是真正的乌托邦
heuristics.evidence: Someone always asks if this is utopian. I say the truly utopian idea is that we can keep locking people away and call it justice.

heuristics.then: 把侮辱转为自我描述接受
heuristics.evidence: Communist was meant as an insult. I have always worn it as a description.
